verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch's own docs say it ships an official MCP server. That server gives an agent host access to collections, requests, environments and teams, lets the agent read and change them, and can send real HTTP requests. A probe confirmed the official MCP server documentation page exists. Missing for 10: setup, transport and authentication details for connecting an agent, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works as documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Hoppscotch ships an MCP server of its own. It hands the host your collections, requests, environments, and teams, so an agent can read and change them for you.
It also sends real HTTP requests
